label: Krusty the Clown
description: A gravel-voiced showbiz clown who's done this drive a thousand times.
direction: Speak in Krusty the Clown's raspy, gravelly, showbiz voice: brash, weary, playing to the crowd, with his trademark wheezy laugh between bits. Keep the direction word clear.
notes: Voice model is a provisional pick from a Fish title search; find_voices.py auditions it and ship_roster.py build writes the final pick here. Character lives on greetings and road prompts; turns stay plain.

rights.source_work: The Simpsons (animated series, from the 1989 debut season)
rights.author: 20th Television, The Walt Disney Company (series created by Matt Groening)
rights.pd_basis: None. Krusty dates from 1989 and remains under copyright; the voice a clone would copy is a copyrighted performance, and The Simpsons is a live trademark.
covered: The 43 lines of navigation dialogue below, which are original writing produced for this pack. A few greetings and alerts deliberately echo the character's well-known catchphrases and personality; those echoes are the rights holder's, not ours.
not_covered: The character, which is not ours and is not in the public domain.
The character's name and The Simpsons name, which are live trademarks.
Any recorded voice performance of the character, by any performer.

The third-party voice model named in `voice`, which was uploaded by a member of the public and presented as a clone of that performance. No permission from the rights holder or the performer is claimed or implied.
Any commercial use. A platform's commercial-rights upsell cannot grant rights the uploader never held.
rights.notes: This preset is in copyright and says so. It is included because the pipeline should not pretend a rights position it does not have; see docs/presets.md before publishing anything built from it. The public-domain presets are pooh, eeyore and tigger.

lines.in_quarter_mile: In a quarter of a mile.
lines.in_1000_meters: In one kilometer. Stay with me, folks!
lines.in_1500_meters: In one point five kilometers. The show must go on!
lines.in_one_mile: In one mile. Hey hey! Big finish coming up.
lines.start_drive_1: Hey hey! It's Krusty! Buckle up, kids!
lines.start_drive_2: Ladies and germs, welcome to the Krusty drive! Let's go!
lines.start_drive_3: Is this thing on? Good. Let's hit the road!
lines.start_drive_4: Hi kids! Who do ya love? Let's drive!
lines.start_drive_5: Mister Teeny, hold the map. Okay, we're rolling!
lines.start_drive_6: Another show, another road. Heh heh heh. Let's go!
lines.start_drive_7: Krusty here, and this drive is brought to you by Krusty Burger!
lines.start_drive_8: Sideshow Mel, cue the music! We're off!
lines.start_drive_9: Hey, I've done tougher crowds. Seat belt on? Let's go!
lines.exit_left: Take the exit on the left.
lines.exit_right: Take the exit on the right.
lines.u_turn: Make a U turn. Heh heh. Nobody saw that, right?
lines.arrived: We're here! Thank you, you've been a wonderful audience!
lines.exit_fifth: take the fifth exit. Hey hey!
lines.exit_sixth: take the sixth exit. Heh heh heh.
lines.exit_seventh: take the seventh exit. This roundabout runs longer than my show!
lines.traffic_ahead: Traffic ahead. Oy. Worse than a Monday matinee.
lines.accident_ahead: An accident ahead. Ooh. Slow down, kids. Safety first.
lines.hazard_ahead: Hazard ahead! Whoa, watch it! I've got a pie in the back.
lines.speed_camera_ahead: Speed camera ahead. Slow down and give 'em the big clown smile.
lines.red_light_camera_ahead: Red light camera ahead. Stop on red, kids. Krusty says so.
lines.police_ahead: Police ahead! Heh heh. Hey, officer, love the hat.
lines.reroute_chime: Whoa! Wrong turn. Cut! Take two. New route!
